# rtichoke

> interactive visualizations for performance of predictive models

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Performance Data
> Functions for preparing model-performance data.

- [prepare_performance_data](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_performance_data.html): Prepare performance data for binary classification models
- [prepare_performance_data_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_performance_data_times.html): Prepare performance data for models with time-to-event outcomes

#### Discrimination
> Functions for evaluating discrimination.

- [create_roc_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_roc_curve.html): Creates a Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve
- [plot_roc_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_roc_curve.html): Plots an ROC curve from pre-computed performance data
- [create_precision_recall_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_precision_recall_curve.html): Creates a Precision-Recall curve
- [plot_precision_recall_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_precision_recall_curve.html): Plots a Precision-Recall curve from pre-computed performance data
- [create_gains_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_gains_curve.html): Creates a Gains curve
- [plot_gains_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_gains_curve.html): Plots a Gains curve from pre-computed performance data
- [create_lift_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_lift_curve.html): Creates a Lift curve
- [plot_lift_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_lift_curve.html): Plots a Lift curve from pre-computed performance data

#### Calibration and Utility
> Functions for calibration and decision-curve analysis.

- [create_calibration_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_calibration_curve.html): Creates Calibration Curve
- [create_decision_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_decision_curve.html): Creates a Decision Curve
- [plot_decision_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_decision_curve.html): Plots a Decision Curve from pre-computed performance data

#### Reports
> Summary reporting helpers.

- [create_summary_report](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_summary_report.html): Create rtichoke Summary Report
